strings.zh: 迷思 1：酒糟皮膚就是「喝酒喝太多」
strings.en: Myth 1: Rosacea is caused by drinking too much alcohol

strings.zh: 迷思 2：玫瑰痤瘡就是皮膚過敏
strings.en: Myth 2: Rosacea is just skin allergy

strings.zh: 迷思 3：酒糟是「螨蟲」造成的，殺蟲就好
strings.en: Myth 3: Rosacea is caused by mites — just kill them

strings.zh: 迷思 4：既然臉上紅紅長痘，我用 A 酸應該也能治
strings.en: Myth 4: My face is red with bumps, so retinoids should work

strings.zh: 迷思 5：臉紅了敷化妝水 / 化妝棉冰敷比較舒服
strings.en: Myth 5: Toner-soaked cotton pads or ice compresses help when face flushes

strings.zh: 迷思 6：玫瑰痤瘡治不好，只能一輩子避開所有刺激
strings.en: Myth 6: Rosacea is incurable — you must avoid every trigger forever

玫瑰痤瘡常見「點火」誘因
過敏反應(IgE-mediated)的特徵是：接觸後幾分鐘到幾小時發作、會癢、有明確誘因、口服抗組織胺有效。而玫瑰痤瘡：
strings.en: IgE-mediated allergy presents within minutes to hours of exposure, is itchy, has clear triggers, and responds to oral antihistamines. Rosacea, by contrast:

strings.zh: 實務：外面市售「除螨皂」、「除螨洗面乳」對玫瑰痤瘡幾乎都沒實證，且許多含刺激性成分，反而會讓酒糟惡化。
strings.en: Practical note: over-the-counter "anti-mite soap" or "anti-mite cleansers" have virtually no evidence for rosacea, and many contain irritating ingredients that actually worsen the condition.

strings.zh: 痘痘和酒糟雖然外觀相似，但機轉完全不同：
strings.en: Acne and rosacea look similar but have completely different mechanisms:

strings.zh: 玫瑰痤瘡保養的紅燈成分：
現代玫瑰痤瘡治療策略已大幅進步：
strings.en: Modern rosacea treatment has advanced dramatically:

strings.zh: 健保：外用 Metronidazole（滅菌靈）、Azelaic acid（雅若）、口服 Doxycycline 低劑量、口服 Minocycline。自費：Ivermectin（舒立美 Soolantra）、Brimonidine（專減紅）、脈衝染料雷射 PDL、強脈衝光 IPL。發炎控制用健保藥已可有 70% 改善，血管擴張靠雷射。
strings.en: NHI-covered: topical metronidazole, azelaic acid, low-dose oral doxycycline, oral minocycline. Out-of-pocket: ivermectin (Soolantra), brimonidine (for redness), pulsed-dye laser (PDL), intense pulsed light (IPL). NHI medications already achieve ~70% improvement in inflammation; persistent telangiectasia requires laser.

strings.zh: **輕度持續性紅斑**:Brimonidine + 防曬 + 屏障修復
strings.en: **Mild persistent erythema**: brimonidine + sun protection + barrier repair

strings.zh: **丘疹膿皰**:Metronidazole 或 Ivermectin 或 Azelaic + 必要時口服 Doxycycline 40 mg(亞抗生素劑量，主要抗發炎）
strings.en: **Papulopustular**: metronidazole, ivermectin, or azelaic acid + oral doxycycline 40 mg if needed (sub-antimicrobial dose, anti-inflammatory)

strings.zh: **毛細血管擴張**：血管雷射(PDL / V Beam)或脈衝光(IPL)— 針對「看得見的紅血絲」根本性治療
strings.en: **Telangiectasia**: vascular laser (PDL / V Beam) or IPL — definitive treatment for visible blood vessels

strings.zh: **鼻贅（rhinophyma 鼻部肥厚）**：口服低劑量 isotretinoin 或雷射 / 手術整形
strings.en: **Rhinophyma (nose thickening)**: low-dose oral isotretinoin or laser/surgical resurfacing

strings.zh: 玫瑰痤瘡跟「喝酒」沒有因果關係
strings.en: Rosacea is not causally related to alcohol consumption

strings.zh: 先天免疫系統過度活化
兩頰、鼻頭、下巴、額頭中央
因為皮膚發炎讓螨蟲容易增生
strings.en: skin inflammation creates conditions for mite overgrowth

strings.zh: 多數玫瑰痤瘡會加重發炎
strings.en: most rosacea cases worsen with retinoids

strings.zh: 降低發炎、修復屏障、避免血管擴張
strings.en: reduce inflammation, repair barrier, avoid vasodilation

strings.zh: 多數酒糟病人會引發明顯刺激
strings.en: trigger significant irritation in most rosacea patients

strings.zh: 果酸 / 高濃度水楊酸 / 高濃度 A 酸
strings.en: AHAs / high-strength salicylic acid / high-strength retinoids

strings.zh: 物理性磨砂膏 / 洗臉刷 / 過度清潔

strings.en: Ice wrapped in a clean towel

strings.zh: 無法根除，但可以高度控制
strings.en: Cannot be cured, but can be very well controlled

strings.zh: 外用藥膏 + 防曬 + 避開個人觸發因素 + 必要時口服 / 雷射
strings.en: Topicals + sun protection + avoiding personal triggers + oral medication or laser when needed

strings.zh: 表現型分類取代過去的亞型分類
strings.en: phenotype-based classification has replaced the old subtype system

strings.zh: Schaller 2020 研究：Ivermectin 1% + Doxycycline 40 mg/day(亞抗生素劑量)
德國 2022 S2k 指引的關鍵更新
strings.en: Key updates in the 2022 German S2k guidelines

strings.zh: Minocycline 已不再列為第一線
Niacinamide（菸鹼醯胺）、Centella（積雪草）、Allantoin、神經醯胺、Azelaic acid
strings.en: Niacinamide, Centella asiatica, allantoin, ceramides, azelaic acid

strings.zh: 不可斷根但能高度控制
口服 Isotretinoin 低劑量(0.1-0.3 mg/kg/day)
不要再用洗面乳磨砂膏狂洗，也不要用治痘痘的 A 酸自己亂治
strings.en: Stop scrubbing with cleansers and exfoliators, and don't self-treat with acne retinoids

strings.zh: 不是過敏、不是螨蟲、不是治不好
strings.en: Not allergy, not mites, not incurable

strings.zh: 血管雷射 PDL / KTP / IPL 6-10 次，可改善毛細血管擴張
strings.en: Vascular laser PDL / KTP / IPL × 6–10 sessions improves telangiectasia

strings.zh: 口服 Isotretinoin / 雷射磨皮(CO₂ / Er:YAG ablative)/ 手術修整
strings.en: Oral isotretinoin / ablative laser resurfacing (CO₂ / Er:YAG) / surgical contouring

strings.zh: 溫熱敷眼瞼 + 眼瞼清潔(Tea tree, 1% lid scrub)
strings.en: Warm eyelid compress + lid hygiene (tea tree, 1% lid scrub)

strings.zh: 口服 Doxycycline 40 mg + 眼科會診；頑固型考慮 Cyclosporine 眼藥水
strings.en: Oral doxycycline 40 mg + ophthalmology consult; cyclosporine eye drops for refractory cases
